units.source_text: 我瞥了一眼那青色，顿觉不安起来。

en.t: I glanced at that blue-green color and at once grew uneasy.

units.source_text: 这少年同我这号人不同，他生命的纯洁的末端正在燃烧。

en.t: Unlike someone like me, this boy was burning at the pure end of his life.

units.source_text: 燃烧之前，他的未来是被隐藏起来的。

en.t: Before it caught fire, his future had been hidden away.

units.source_text: 未来的灯芯浸泡在透明的冰凉的灯油里。

en.t: The wick of the future was soaked in clear, cold lamp oil.

units.source_text: 倘使未来只留下纯洁和无垢的话，那么谁又有必要预见自己的纯洁和无垢呢？

en.t: If the future leaves behind only purity and innocence, then who needs to foresee their own purity and innocence?
